reviewScope: Pearl records missing both valid numeric shell thickness and meaningful bearing edge, blocking meaningful core-shell pass.
reviewRules: Do not write Firestore updates from this packet.
Find source-backed numeric shell thickness and source-backed bearing edge geometry.
Shell thickness must be numeric in millimeters, or a clearly convertible numeric measurement.
Bearing edge must be source-backed and specific enough to be meaningful.
Do not use confidence fields as substitutes for actual physical shell data.
Do not infer thickness or bearing edge from shell material, construction, line name, hoop type, or era alone.
Line-level promotion requires source evidence that clearly applies across the listed models/era.
